metric_definitions.exact_score_accuracy: Predicted regulation/final scoreline exactly equals the stored final scoreline.
metric_definitions.log_loss: Negative natural logarithm of the probability assigned to the actual H/D/A result. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.multiclass_brier: Sum of squared probability errors across H/D/A. Range 0 to 2. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.result_pick_accuracy: Highest-probability H/D/A selection equals the verified final match result.
